definition: Imposed from outside the tradition, as a building-code minimum is, rather than learned from historic buildings. The fall of grade away from a Georgian house is one; there the code's figure happens to agree with period practice.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on a figure's kind: "invented: no precedent exists. code: imposed from outside." kits/georgian-colonial-american.kit.json rainwater.grade_fall_min.note: "which is also the IRC's own figure and agrees with the period practice of falling grade away from a water table."
